name: Tavia Savoury
title: Instructor: nails, brows, threading, makeup and waxing
intro: Tavia is an esthetician and brow artist who runs her own brow studio in Ajax, with experience across skin care, lashes and clinic management.
description: Tavia Savoury, NAE instructor for nails, brows, threading, makeup and waxing.

sections.heading: About Tavia
sections.source: Tavia's resume (ResumeTaviaSavoury.pdf, Drive, Aug 2026). Other employers not named; status wording left out. Tavia approves the wording. Published 11 Nov 2026: Kalleigh confirmed Tavia teaches with NAE (Jules).
body: Tavia has worked as an esthetician since 2020, as a brow specialist for a major cosmetics brand and as the manager of a teaching clinic, where she supported students through their practical hours.
Today she runs her own brow studio, so students learn from someone who does the work for paying clients every week.

sections.heading: What Tavia teaches
sections.source: NAE welcome email to Tavia (3 Sep 2026): Nails, Brows, Threading, Makeup, Waxing.
